name: Fenlow Vault 82 EGEO
description: Key Features Spacious Deck Area: Offers a generous 127 square metres of usable deck space, providing ample room for gatherings, equipment, or staging activities. High Freeboard: Features a freeboard height of 395 centimetres, enhancing safety by reducing the risk of water ingress and ensuring stability in various water conditions. Large Occupancy Capacity: Designed to accommodate up to 47 people comfortably, making it suitable for group events, operations, or crew activities. Mooring Depth: Capable of being securely moored in waters up to 179 metres deep, supporting flexible placement in a wide range of aquatic environments. Station Keeping: Operates with a free drift station-keeping method, allowing for stable positioning without the need for complex anchoring systems. Fetch-Limited Design: Engineered to perform reliably in environments with controlled wave exposure, enhancing durability and operational safety. Main Benefits Versatile Usage: The expansive deck and high occupancy make this pontoon stage ideal for events, marine construction, floating platforms, or temporary workspaces. Safety and Stability: The elevated freeboard and robust construction deliver peace of mind for users, especially in dynamic water conditions. Easy Deployment: The fetch-limited, free drift design simplifies setup and reduces the need for specialized mooring equipment. Adaptable Placement: Suitable for deep water applications up to 179 metres, offering flexibility for diverse marine projects or recreational uses. Typical Use Cases and Outcomes Event Hosting: Perfect for outdoor events, performances, or gatherings on water, supporting up to 47 attendees with plenty of space for movement. Marine Operations: Well-suited for use as a floating work platform, staging area for construction, or base for scientific research in both shallow and deep water. Temporary Docking: Acts as a reliable temporary dock or landing stage for boats and watercraft in marinas, lakes, or coastal areas. Safe Access: Provides a stable and secure platform for embarking, disembarking, or equipment handling, addressing common safety concerns. Frequently Asked Questions Addressed Durability: Built to withstand typical wave exposure in fetch-limited environments, ensuring long-lasting performance. Ease of Use: No complex anchoring required thanks to the free drift station keeping—quick to deploy and reposition as needed. Compatibility: Suitable for a wide range of marine applications, from leisure to industrial use, and adaptable to various water depths. This pontoon stage is an optimal solution for anyone needing a large, safe, and flexible floating platform with straightforward deployment and reliable performance in diverse aquatic settings.
description_html:
Key Features

  • Spacious Deck Area: Offers a generous 127 square metres of usable deck space, providing ample room for gatherings, equipment, or staging activities.
  • High Freeboard: Features a freeboard height of 395 centimetres, enhancing safety by reducing the risk of water ingress and ensuring stability in various water conditions.
  • Large Occupancy Capacity: Designed to accommodate up to 47 people comfortably, making it suitable for group events, operations, or crew activities.
  • Mooring Depth: Capable of being securely moored in waters up to 179 metres deep, supporting flexible placement in a wide range of aquatic environments.
  • Station Keeping: Operates with a free drift station-keeping method, allowing for stable positioning without the need for complex anchoring systems.
  • Fetch-Limited Design: Engineered to perform reliably in environments with controlled wave exposure, enhancing durability and operational safety.

Main Benefits

  • Versatile Usage: The expansive deck and high occupancy make this pontoon stage ideal for events, marine construction, floating platforms, or temporary workspaces.
  • Safety and Stability: The elevated freeboard and robust construction deliver peace of mind for users, especially in dynamic water conditions.
  • Easy Deployment: The fetch-limited, free drift design simplifies setup and reduces the need for specialized mooring equipment.
  • Adaptable Placement: Suitable for deep water applications up to 179 metres, offering flexibility for diverse marine projects or recreational uses.

Typical Use Cases and Outcomes

  • Event Hosting: Perfect for outdoor events, performances, or gatherings on water, supporting up to 47 attendees with plenty of space for movement.
  • Marine Operations: Well-suited for use as a floating work platform, staging area for construction, or base for scientific research in both shallow and deep water.
  • Temporary Docking: Acts as a reliable temporary dock or landing stage for boats and watercraft in marinas, lakes, or coastal areas.
  • Safe Access: Provides a stable and secure platform for embarking, disembarking, or equipment handling, addressing common safety concerns.

Frequently Asked Questions Addressed

  • Durability: Built to withstand typical wave exposure in fetch-limited environments, ensuring long-lasting performance.
  • Ease of Use: No complex anchoring required thanks to the free drift station keeping—quick to deploy and reposition as needed.
  • Compatibility: Suitable for a wide range of marine applications, from leisure to industrial use, and adaptable to various water depths.

This pontoon stage is an optimal solution for anyone needing a large, safe, and flexible floating platform with straightforward deployment and reliable performance in diverse aquatic settings.
